title: Ɗaɗi caggal Jappeere
intro: Aɗa darii e nder cuuɗi laamu ɓooyngu mawngu, ɗo laamɗo baawɗo bayyinde hoore mum laamɗo dow yimɓe fof. Ko adii oo laamɗo ina darii maccuɗo dewondirɗo, halfinaaɗo yiɗdeeji ɓurɗi mawnude e laamu nguu. Ɓe kawri, ɓe peewnitoo, ɓe caliima heɗaade jeertinaali nulaaɗo nelaaɗo ngam ardude e maɓɓe. Mbele aɗa waawi anndude hol ko oo maccuɗo tiiɗɗo wonnoo?
clues: Miɗo wuuri e laamu mawngu ngu neɗɗo baawɗo laamde, wiyɗo ina jogii laamɗo e dow yimɓe fof.
Miin ko mi jaagorde hoolaare oo laamɗo, miɗo huutoroo kala ko ɓe njiɗi e yamiroore maɓɓe.
Nde nelaaɗo Alla ari e leydi amen ina nodda en e goonga, miin e laamɗo am, min calii heɗaade.
Mi yamiraama yoo mi huɓɓu yiite mawnde, mi feewna birikaaji loope ngam mahngo mawngo.
Laamɗo am oo yiɗiino mahde ŋoral toowngal haa yettoo asamaan oo e koye mum.
Haa ragare, laamiiɗo am, e konu amin, min ɗon ƴakka, min ɗon ƴakka nder maayo.

arabic: أَسْبَـٰبَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ فَأَطَّلِعَ إِلَىٰٓ إِلَـٰهِ مُوسَىٰ وَإِنِّى لَأَظُنُّهُۥ كَـٰذِبًۭا ۚ وَكَذَٰلِكَ زُيِّنَ لِفِرْعَوْنَ سُوٓءُ عَمَلِهِۦ وَصُدَّ عَنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ ۚ وَمَا كَيْدُ فِرْعَوْنَ إِلَّا فِى تَبَابٍۢ
verse: The ways into the heavens - so that I may look at the deity of Moses; but indeed, I think he is a liar." And thus was made attractive to Pharaoh the evil of his deed, and he was averted from the [right] way. And the plan of Pharaoh was not except in ruin. (40:37)
